scenarios.name: Complete fever interview — all stages

input.content: I have a fever and chills
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Fever. Do you confirm?
How long have you had the fever?
Did it start suddenly or gradually?
Please inspect skin for rash or infection.
No rash visible, no skin lesions

output.currentHistoryTaking: The patient is a 45-year-old male presenting with fever and chills for three days. The fever started gradually. No other details about character, severity, or aggravating/relieving factors were provided.
output.associatedSymptoms: Patient confirmed cough (dry) and mild headache. Patient denied rash.
output.pastMedicalHistory: Patient denies any previous chronic illnesses.
output.physicalExam: Skin inspection revealed no rash visible and no skin lesions.

scenarios.name: Only symptom identified — no further stages

input.content: It swelled up after I fell on deck
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Joint Pain or Swelling. Do you confirm?

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient reports knee pain with swelling following a fall on deck. No further history obtained.

scenarios.name: All associated symptoms denied

input.content: If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Headache. Do you confirm?

output.currentHistoryTaking: 30-year-old female patient reports headache that started this morning.
output.associatedSymptoms: Patient denied nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, neck stiffness, and sensitivity to light.

scenarios.name: German patient — full output in English

input.content: Wenn ich das richtig verstehe, ist die Hauptbeschwerde Bauchschmerzen. Bestätigen Sie?
Ja, und ich habe einmal erbrochen

output.currentHistoryTaking: 52-year-old male presenting with abdominal pain that began 8 hours ago.
output.associatedSymptoms: Patient reports nausea and one episode of vomiting. Denies fever.

scenarios.name: Unresponsive patient on supplemental oxygen

input.content: Patient found unconscious in his cabin
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Altered Consciousness or Confusion. Do you confirm?
Medical officer, is the patient on supplemental oxygen?

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient found unconscious in his cabin.

scenarios.name: Hallucination trap — patient gives no real answers

input.content: I feel pain in my back
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Back Pain. Do you confirm?

output.currentHistoryTaking: The patient is a crew member presenting with back pain. They confirmed this as their main complaint. The patient declined to provide their age. They stated they do not know when the pain started and were unsure about the character of the pain.
output.medications: Patient states they cannot remember current medications.

scenarios.name: Blood pressure asked and answered as two separate values

input.content: If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Chest pain. Do you confirm?

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient is a 60-year-old male presenting with chest pain. No further history of presenting complaint was obtained as the interview proceeded directly to vital signs.

scenarios.name: Spanish patient, English medical officer

input.content: Si entiendo correctamente, la queja principal es Dolor en el pecho. ¿Confirmas?
¿El dolor se irradia a algún lado?
Sí, al brazo izquierdo y la mandíbula

output.currentHistoryTaking: 48-year-old male with chest pain radiating to the left arm and jaw. Patient reports significant shortness of breath. No other history details provided.
output.associatedSymptoms: Patient reports significant shortness of breath.

scenarios.name: Symptom never confirmed by patient

input.content: Can you describe what is wrong?
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Fatigue or Exhaustion. Do you confirm?

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient reports feeling generally unwell and tired. When asked to confirm the main complaint as Fatigue or Exhaustion, patient expressed uncertainty by saying 'Maybe, I'm not sure.' No further history was obtained.

scenarios.name: Trauma — AVPU Voice, no investigations, wound exam

input.content: Patient hit his head on a crane
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Trauma. Do you confirm?
Yes, laceration on the forehead, controlled with pressure
No investigations required for this case.
Is there visible deformity of the skull?
Is the laceration deep — subcutaneous tissue visible?
Yes, deep laceration, subcutaneous tissue visible

output.currentHistoryTaking: 33-year-old male who hit his head on a crane. There was a brief loss of consciousness lasting approximately 10 seconds. He has a visible laceration on the forehead which was controlled with pressure. He reports mild neck pain.
output.physicalExam: Skull examination: No visible deformity. Laceration examination: Deep laceration with subcutaneous tissue visible. Bleeding: Controlled with pressure, minimal oozing present.

scenarios.name: AVPU Pain — semi-conscious patient

input.content: Patient is very drowsy, won't wake up properly
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Altered Consciousness or Confusion. Do you confirm?

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient is very drowsy and won't wake up properly. No further history was obtained as the patient is not responsive enough to provide detailed information.

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient confirmed shortness of breath as the main complaint. No further history was obtained.

Warfarin 5mg daily, bisoprolol 10mg daily, lisinopril 10mg daily, aspirin 100mg daily, atorvastatin 40mg at night

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient is a 67-year-old male presenting with chest pain. No further history of presenting complaint was obtained beyond demographic information.

scenarios.name: Penicillin allergy with anaphylaxis — must be captured precisely

input.content: I have a rash all over my body
If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Rash. Do you confirm?
Yes, penicillin — causes anaphylaxis. Also ibuprofen gives me hives.

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient is a 29-year-old female presenting with a rash that started approximately two hours ago.
output.allergies: Penicillin — causes anaphylaxis; ibuprofen — causes hives.

Есть ли у вас хронические заболевания?

output.currentHistoryTaking: 41-year-old male patient presents with abdominal pain. The pain started yesterday evening, approximately 8 hours ago. The patient reports the pain is located in the right lower quadrant of the abdomen.
output.associatedSymptoms: Patient reports nausea but denies vomiting.

input.content: If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Chest pain. Do you confirm?
ST elevation in leads II, III and aVF

scenarios.name: Partial interview — stages 1 to 4 only

input.content: If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Palpitations. Do you confirm?
Irregular, like the heart is skipping
Do you feel dizzy or lightheaded?

output.currentHistoryTaking: 38-year-old female presenting with palpitations that started 3 hours ago. The palpitations are irregular, described as the heart skipping. She reports mild dizziness. No chest pain. No previous heart problems or thyroid problems.
output.associatedSymptoms: Patient reports mild dizziness. Denies chest pain.
output.pastMedicalHistory: Patient denies any previous heart problems and thyroid problems.

scenarios.name: Partial vitals — only SpO2, HR, BP provided; others not measured

input.content: If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Dizziness or Vertigo. Do you confirm?
We don't have a way to measure that

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient confirms the main complaint is dizziness or vertigo. No further history was obtained.
output.additionalNotes: Medical officer reported that respiratory rate cannot be measured due to lack of equipment. Temperature measurement not available due to no thermometer on board.

output.associatedSymptoms: Patient reports nausea (mild) and photophobia (sensitivity to light). Patient denies vomiting.

scenarios.name: Physical exam with positive findings — all must appear in physicalExam

input.content: If I understand correctly, the main complaint is Abdominal Pain. Do you confirm?
Yes, guarding in the right iliac fossa

output.currentHistoryTaking: Patient reports severe abdominal pain. No additional history was obtained beyond the confirmation of the chief complaint.
output.physicalExam: Abdominal examination revealed board-like rigidity of the abdomen, guarding in the right iliac fossa, positive rebound tenderness, and absent bowel sounds.
